description: Solid Waste Management Districts is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The Harmonized Waste Collection Area layer covers the entire City of Toronto. These boundaries are used for management purposes of daytime collection routes. This data set includes management boundaries for the harmonized waste collection areas within the City of Toronto. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are garbage collection area, garbage route, waste collection area. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-07-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is open-government-licence-toronto. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
